_comment: Data-driven scene-transition loading screen (docs/game-production/StandaloneParityGaps.md §2). Loaded by UI::loadGameScreenInto(ui,"loading",...) into loading:<panel> screens while SceneManager reports SceneTransitionStyle::LoadingScreen via SceneCallbacks::setLoadingScreen. {{loading_target}} resolves to the destination scene's display name via MenuActions.onResolveVariable.
